title: EMOTHE - Teatro europeo de los siglos XVI y XVII: patrimonio y bases de datos
notes: EMOTHE at the Universitat de València (site live 200) studies and edits the canon of early modern European theatre (Italian, English, French, Portuguese, Spanish, 16th–17th c.); its digital library has ~350 TEI-XML editions (originales y traducciones) with ids like EMOTHE0357, EMOTHE0382. TEI files (TEI-All validated) are openly distributed via GitLab (gitlab.com/emothe/emothe-research-project) and the Zenodo community zenodo.org/communities/emothe; workflow is FileMaker + oXygen, not TEITOK. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it). The GitLab repository holds 57 XML files; the full set of about 374 texts is not linked from the site.
institution: Universitat de Valencia (proyecto ARTELOPE; founders Joan Oleza, current PI Jesus Tronch Perez)
